newsitem.title: UK: BFI down one as Panamaxes ease.
newsitem.headline: BFI down one as Panamaxes ease.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was down one point on Wednesday at 1,289 points with brokers reporting rates for Panamaxes easing in both the Atlantic and Pacific.
Halla were said to have fixed Rialto U.S. Gulf to Japan 54,000 heavy grain June 8/20 at $21.30 no combo.
Caper rates in the Atlantic were said to be appreciating with some brokers anticipating $20,000 daily being paid shortly for modern vessels for trips from the Atlantic to the Far East.
Rates for craned bulk carriers from the Continent to the Fra East were also said to be firmer.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was five points down to 10 points up and turnover was 34 lots.
